rationale: The short premise required price to stay below the 5m 9-EMA ($125.09) and VWAP, but price has reclaimed the 9-EMA and the last five 1m bars are a rising sequence (124.94→125.10) with expanding volume (42k on the latest bar), signaling near-term buyers.
